item: Inherited v10 energy row-level original bibliography
why_absent: The donor model and dated fixes survive, but the publications and calculation chain behind every inherited energy parameter were not retained.
upgrade_source: Recover the original v7-v10 source package or rebuild a row-level register from authoritative DOE, PSA and technology-cost datasets.

item: Original model units for technology-specific activity and capacity rows
why_absent: The raw CSVs retain values and OSeMOSYS coordinates, but several non-energy CLEWs technologies use land, water or crop activity units rather than GW/PJ conventions and no complete unit dictionary survived.
upgrade_source: Export the FUEL/TECHNOLOGY unit metadata from the exact pinned clewsy build and reconcile it against InputActivityRatio, OutputActivityRatio and CapacityToActivityUnit.

item: Original byte checksums for the 90 downloaded GAEZ crop rasters
why_absent: The exact filenames, URLs, source-table rows and selection logic were recovered, but the clean temporary cache itself was not frozen and no original per-file checksums survive.
upgrade_source: Re-download the 90 URLs in GAEZ_PHL_RASTER_CACHE_MANIFEST.csv, retain the bytes and append independently verified SHA-256 values without claiming identity to the lost temporary bytes.

item: GADM 4.1 source archive checksum and original access date
why_absent: The extracted level-0 shapefile components survive, but the downloaded archive and acquisition log do not.
upgrade_source: Retain the original or re-downloaded GADM 4.1 PHL archive with provider metadata, access date and SHA-256, then verify geometry equality.

item: Original upstream acquisition dates for bundled FAOSTAT SSP2 and GAEZ base-raster files
why_absent: The build session establishes the 2026-07-25 workflow date and the ledger establishes the 2026-08-05 recovery date, but it does not establish when upstream maintainers first acquired each bundled source file.
upgrade_source: Recover immutable upstream release manifests or maintainer acquisition records; do not substitute the reconstruction date for an unknown historical acquisition date.

item: PAGASA gauge precipitation series and station metadata
why_absent: The installed national normal uses ERA5 reanalysis; no retained PAGASA station/gauge extract was available for a country-weighted 1991-2020 reconstruction.
upgrade_source: Obtain PAGASA quality-controlled station series, station metadata and an explicit national aggregation method; compare against ERA5 before replacing the anchor.
notes: ERA5 is retained and clearly labeled reanalysis.

item: Raw CCKP HTTP response-body hashes
why_absent: The retained evidence is a normalized compilation with exact API URLs and values, but original response files and their download-time hashes were not preserved.
upgrade_source: Re-download each exact endpoint, store raw JSON responses and response headers, and record one SHA-256 per response in SOURCES.csv.
notes: The normalized snapshot itself is retained and hash-verified.

item: Environmental-flow-adjusted surface availability
why_absent: The 125.79 km3/year figure is national surface-water potential, not dependable yield after environmental-flow reservation, storage, seasonality and conveyance losses.
upgrade_source: National/basin dependable-yield studies, environmental-flow requirements, reservoir operating rules and observed allocation/withdrawal data.
notes: The installed UCC is explicitly a sensitivity ceiling.

item: Aquifer stock, head and safe yield
why_absent: The 20.2 km3/year figure is national potential flow. The model has no aquifer polygons, initial head, saturated thickness, area, storage coefficient, natural discharge or admissible drawdown.
upgrade_source: Aquifer-resolved hydrogeology and observed head series crosswalked to demand and recharge nodes; add a formulation that carries groundwater state between years.
notes: No groundwater stock or depletion claim is made.

item: Seasonal and interannual water scarcity
why_absent: The installed annual median path cannot represent dry-season stress, typhoon sequencing, El Nino/La Nina variability or storage carryover.
upgrade_source: PAGASA seasonal rainfall, basin runoff/recharge models, reservoir storage and seasonal demand/withdrawal data.
notes: CCKP seasonal anomalies are retained as context but not installed.

item: Pumping energy, lift and cost calibration
why_absent: Inherited pumping-electricity links are retained, but groundwater lift, pumping efficiency, source depth and public/power pumping costs are not calibrated.
upgrade_source: NWRB permits/well records, utility production and energy records, groundwater levels and pump efficiencies by source.
notes: The water link is physical 1:1; it does not determine the least-cost source split credibly.

item: Consistent national withdrawal boundary
why_absent: The PSA 218.46 bcm abstraction includes large non-consumptive hydropower; AQUASTAT variable 4250 includes agricultural uses beyond irrigation; and the policy-note current-use figure and model withdrawals use different boundaries.
upgrade_source: Reconcile NWRB permits, PSA physical water accounts, NIA irrigation diversions, MWSS/LWUA/utility production, industrial self-supply and hydropower return flows.
notes: The AQUASTAT 2006 and 2020 comparisons are now retained as boundary benchmarks; no observed source or sector share is calibrated.

item: Cell-level land-cluster geometry and basin/aquifer crosswalk
why_absent: The companion repository retains summary files and a cluster-map image but not cell membership geometry needed to allocate coefficient classes to basins or aquifers.
upgrade_source: Recover or recreate the original classified raster and retain a reproducible cell-to-cluster/basin/aquifer crosswalk.
priority: low for national model; high for spatial rebuild
notes: The whole-country model does not require this artifact.

item: Groundwater-dependent ecosystems and natural discharge
why_absent: No national dataset was available to deduct baseflow, spring discharge or ecosystem requirements from the potential-flow ceiling.
upgrade_source: Hydrogeologic water balances, baseflow separation, spring inventories and ecosystem flow requirements by aquifer/basin.
notes: The groundwater ceiling is not safe yield.

item: Original v13 calibration workbook bytes
why_absent: The workbook file was not retained, although its SHA-256, selected factors, formulas, source hierarchy, and all installed values survive in calibration_generation.json and the current model.
upgrade_source: Recover the workbook whose recorded SHA-256 is c8601bf26acce39d6e661a9f5bcb4801c4de401a5b73ce212f9115cca5ba63f8 and verify it against the retained values.
notes: This is an evidence-byte gap, not a missing model-value or calculation gap.

item: Original v13 source-case and full CBC result bytes
why_absent: The installed v13 folder and BASE_V13 result files were not frozen. Their hashes, solve identity, exact extracted 2020 capacities, fingerprints, formulas, and validation narrative survive inside the v15-retained v14 records.
upgrade_source: Recover files matching the retained hashes and store them under evidence/stock_turnover without replacing the current records.
notes: All v14 stock values derived from them are retained exactly in stock_turnover_generation.json and PARAMETER_CHANGE_LOG.csv.

item: Local copies and checksums of some v14 official publications
why_absent: The v14 source register retained exact public URLs and selections but did not freeze every DOE, LTO, PSA, NTRC, WGC, and IRENA publication byte.
upgrade_source: Download the exact cited editions, retain them without replacing the register, and append verified checksums.
notes: The citations, model use, formulas, assumptions, and every changed parameter value are already retained.

item: Crop- and system-specific irrigation diversion efficiency
why_absent: The 38 percent national factor cannot represent crop season conveyance system or regional variation; AQUASTAT's comparable 2006 pair gives 50.74 percent while its current 2020 4250/4260 pair crosses agricultural and irrigation-only boundaries.
upgrade_source: NIA diversion and service-area records plus crop-specific field application measurements.
notes: AQUASTAT is retained as a benchmark only. The installed 0.38 factor is unchanged and corrects the net-versus-gross accounting boundary without calibrating irrigated area.

item: National annual public-water use and NRW series
why_absent: No harmonized national delivered-use and utility-production series was available for every model year.
upgrade_source: PSA physical water accounts plus MWSS LWUA and local water-district billed and produced volumes.
notes: The model therefore uses 70 litres/person/day and 25 percent NRW as transparent national assumptions.

item: Groundwater head and pumping efficiency by use
why_absent: The one-region case has no observed dynamic head or combined pump-motor efficiency for public supply and power water.
upgrade_source: NWRB well records groundwater levels and utility or plant pumping electricity.
notes: The installed 50 metre and 70 percent assumptions prevent free pumping but do not calibrate source shares.

item: Irrigation service-area composition and retirement
why_absent: The national 2.006 Mha stock is not split by crop, model input class, scheme age or remaining life; it is therefore mapped to the currently represented high-input irrigated-rice option and held as maintained available capacity.
upgrade_source: NIA scheme-level service area crop allocation commissioning rehabilitation and retirement records.
notes: Use remains endogenous and no activity minimum share or UDC is installed; replace the aggregate mapping when a national scheme register is available.

item: Spatial rice calibration
why_absent: National regime yields and costs do not identify their distribution across the eight GAEZ land clusters; preserving inherited relative cluster yields allows the optimizer to concentrate rice in higher-yield clusters.
upgrade_source: PSA or NIA province-level irrigated/rainfed physical area production and cost data mapped to the model clusters.
notes: The 2020 solve selects 2.006 Mha irrigated area but produces 16.2883 Mt there versus the 14.57 Mt national benchmark because of endogenous spatial selection. Do not correct this with a crop-area constraint.

item: Future rice production costs
why_absent: The model holds the closest national 2021 irrigated and non-irrigated palay cost per kilogram constant in real terms.
upgrade_source: A consistent PSA cost-and-returns time series plus documented real input-price and productivity projections.
notes: The constant pair is preferable to the inherited token cost but is not a forecast.

item: Representative irrigation expansion cost
why_absent: The DA-PRDP PHP300000/ha value is an indicative generic planning cost rather than a realized national mean and does not distinguish gravity pumping rehabilitation or scheme size.
upgrade_source: NIA project-level approved cost and incremental service-area records with scheme technology classification.
notes: The proxy affects only optional new capacity and does not change the sunk initial stock.

item: Portable v16 archive refresh
why_absent: The retained v16.0.0 portable archive is the 2026-08-05 migration baseline and predates the documented 2026-08-07 water-demand and irrigated-rice source changes.
upgrade_source: Regenerate the compact result-free archive from the current live source case in the next explicit packaging or release task.
notes: The current live inputs and exact deltas are traceable in MODEL_MAP.csv and retained manifests; no large result files need to enter the archive.

item: Subnational achieved crop yields
why_absent: Only unit-matched 2020 national achieved yields are frozen; GAEZ supplies attainable potential rather than observed achieved yield by cluster.
upgrade_source: Freeze PSA regional production and exactly matched area definitions by crop and water regime then calculate cluster-compatible achieved coefficients.
notes: National yields are applied uniformly so absolute production per area is correct nationally while spatial yield variation remains unresolved.

item: Crop-specific spatial water allocation
why_absent: Uniform national yields leave cluster choice endogenous against heterogeneous inherited crop-water coefficients; the repair materially changes irrigated-rice water use even though its national area is unchanged.
upgrade_source: Reconcile subnational crop area irrigation source and crop-water requirement observations to the eight cluster definitions.
notes: Do not add crop or water shares to hide this gap; reported subnational and crop-specific water results remain calibration-sensitive.

item: Harvested area versus physical land and cropping intensity
why_absent: Annual harvested area is the best available unit-matched proxy for rainfed annual crops but may count the same physical hectare more than once.
upgrade_source: Combine PSA harvested area with crop-specific cropping-intensity or physical planted-area evidence compatible with model land stocks.
notes: Irrigated rice instead uses physical irrigation service area; perennial coconut area is a direct physical-area proxy.

item: CRPTOM and CRPOTH aggregate composition
why_absent: The existing aggregate commodities are retained and their 2020 aggregate yield bases are corrected but changing component mix is not represented.
upgrade_source: Add component commodities and technologies only in a separately scoped structural extension supported by component demand area cost water and emissions data.
notes: No new object is required for this data repair; results are valid only for the retained aggregate definitions.

item: Coconut-to-copra processing boundary
why_absent: CRPCON is whole coconut with husk and v16 has no copra commodity, drying process, moisture basis, conversion loss, cost, energy use or copra demand.
upgrade_source: Add a separately sourced copra commodity and conversion technology only if a future study requires processed coconut products.
notes: Do not silently apply one mass factor to CRPCON; PCA varietal means show roughly 4.5-5.3 kg whole fruit per kg copra before process-specific refinements.

item: Offshore hourly aggregation and resource-ceiling alignment
why_absent: The NREL report provides zone annual means and states that hourly grid-cell data exist, but the exact hourly zone files are not frozen here; the inherited 30-timeslice relative shape is therefore retained. The existing broad offshore activity ceiling is not redefined by this correction.
upgrade_source: Freeze the NREL Southeast Asia hourly zone/grid-cell dataset, document eligible-area coverage, aggregate it to the model timeslices, and align an offshore capacity or generation ceiling to the same geography.
notes: The annual net CF is sourced exactly; do not infer a best-resource tier from the retired _T1 suffix.

item: Philippine geothermal outage and steam-field availability series
why_absent: The restored 0.9 availability is the inherited engineering assumption; DOE generation and capacity data provide utilization benchmarks but do not separate outages, steam-field decline, curtailment and economic dispatch.
upgrade_source: Plant-level DOE availability, outage and steam-field production records by year, with planned and forced outage definitions compatible with OSeMOSYS AvailabilityFactor.
notes: Do not fit AF directly to gross generation because generation is an endogenous outcome.

item: Cluster paddy soil percolation and scheme delivery efficiency
why_absent: Only a national 38 percent delivery observation and FAO soil-class engineering values are frozen; the eight model clusters lack matched scheme soil and conveyance measurements.
upgrade_source: NIA scheme design reports and monitored diversion field-delivery and soil-percolation records mapped to the eight cluster geometries.
notes: Do not fit coefficients to national withdrawal totals or impose cluster water shares.

item: Irrigation return-flow partition and future cropping intensity
why_absent: The current structure does not distinguish recoverable paddy seepage drainage and conveyance returns and the annualization uses the 2020 national cropping-intensity ratio through 2053.
upgrade_source: Scheme water-balance studies with recoverable fractions and crop-season projections linked to physical service area by cluster.
notes: A future structural extension must preserve gross withdrawals and avoid double counting return water.

item: Forest transition dynamics and benefit sensitivity
why_absent: v17 installs national cumulative expansion and eligibility envelopes but lacks gross inter-year transition flows, parcel suitability, survival, costs, lags and alternative forest-benefit cases.
upgrade_source: Observed land-use transition matrices; legal forestland and tenure overlays; slope, soil, biodiversity and restoration suitability; programme survival, costs and duration; conversion costs; policy benefit valuation; run 0, -5, -10 and higher-benefit cases.
notes: The 2.5 thousand km2/year policy-rate proxy prevents the solved instantaneous jump but is not measured net forest-cover change.

item: Official PSA/NAMRIA and FAO publication bytes for v17 land evidence
why_absent: Publisher anti-bot responses returned HTTP 403 for PSA files and reset the FAO connection during packaging.
upgrade_source: Download the exact URLs frozen in snapshots/land_cover_2020.json when publisher access permits and add their checksums without changing the normalized inputs.
notes: The exact normalized transcription, locators, mapping, arithmetic and source URLs are retained now.

item: Spatial allocation of national land-cover classes to the eight yield clusters
why_absent: The retained PSA/NAMRIA table is national and no defensible overlay with the model cluster geometries was available.
upgrade_source: Overlay NAMRIA Land Cover Map 2020 with the retained eight-cluster polygons and aggregate each model class by cluster.
notes: v17 deliberately avoids unsupported pro-rata cluster pins.

item: Forest transition dynamics and current parcel suitability
why_absent: v17 installs a national cumulative expansion envelope and a documented 80 percent historical planning screen but lacks gross inter-year transition flows, a current parcel overlay, survival, costs and lags.
upgrade_source: Observed land-use transition matrices; legal forestland and tenure overlays; slope, soil, biodiversity and restoration suitability; programme survival, costs and duration; conversion costs.
notes: The 80 percent screen is forest-only and the 2.5 thousand km2/year policy-rate proxy is not measured net forest-cover change.

item: Idle/fallow land hydrology
why_absent: Mode 2 uses LOTHTOT and therefore inherits the existing other-land hydrology proxy rather than measured idle/fallow coefficients.
upgrade_source: National or cluster-specific idle/fallow runoff, evapotranspiration and precipitation-partition evidence.
notes: The proxy is explicit and does not create a per-cluster area cap.

item: Common energy-cost price year
why_absent: The inherited model declares USD and cost units but no real or nominal price year; v18 sources span 2020-2025.
upgrade_source: Adopt and document one model-wide real price year then rebase every capital fixed and variable cost with a retained deflator series.
notes: V18 uses source-year dollars directly and labels each reference year rather than claiming false constant dollars.

item: Exact DOE coal calorific-value table byte and locator
why_absent: PR 1 reports the DOE official value as approximately 22.1 GJ/t but the exact table was not retained or independently located.
upgrade_source: Retain the exact DOE coal import or energy-balance table with fuel basis and year.
notes: V18 records this as a conversion check only and does not change the coal-price path.

item: Post-2024 domestic gas production profile
why_absent: Observed DOE production is available through 2024 but a public annual Malampaya Phase 4 and supplementary-field production profile is not retained.
upgrade_source: DOE or operator field development plan with annual deliverability and reserve basis.
notes: V18 uses a transparent 0.8 percent annual decline envelope after 2024.

item: Long-term Philippine landed LNG price path
why_absent: Observed 2023-2025 landed values do not define a defensible 2053 forecast.
upgrade_source: DOE or ERC long-term landed LNG forecast with shipping regasification contract and real-price basis.
notes: V18 anchors 2023 and 2024 then preserves the inherited mild path shape.

item: Philippine first-of-a-kind SMR project cost
why_absent: No Philippine SMR has a financed project cost or operating record.
upgrade_source: Bankable Philippine vendor EPC financing owner cost and contingency study.
notes: The NREL 8000 USD/kW benchmark is a central technology proxy, not a project quote.

item: Long-term Philippine technology deployment scaling after 2029
why_absent: The 2030-2053 expansion envelopes are defensible policy-neutral upper bounds rather than forecasts of supply-chain, permitting, finance or grid capability.
upgrade_source: Annual Philippine project pipeline, interconnection queue, permitting duration, domestic construction capacity, finance closures and transmission commissioning plan by technology.
notes: Sensitivity testing is required for policy conclusions that bind on these later-period envelopes.

item: Distinct geothermal greenfield and existing-field repowering costs
why_absent: PHL_POW_GEO_OLD is the only geothermal technology, so expansion and replacement allowances share one inherited cost, performance and lifetime representation.
upgrade_source: Philippine field-specific greenfield exploration/EPC and existing-field make-up drilling, refurbishment, lifetime and performance evidence.
notes: No geothermal technology or commodity is added in this implementation.

item: Irrigation delivery-loss destination and recoverable return flow
why_absent: The 0.38 delivery factor identifies the gross-to-field loss but available evidence does not allocate the remaining 62 percent among evaporation, drainage, seepage, recoverable surface return and aquifer recharge by cluster or crop.
upgrade_source: NIA scheme water balances and monitored diversion-to-field studies with recoverable return fractions mapped to model clusters.
notes: The present repair keeps the loss outside the field hydrology boundary and does not manufacture a return-flow split.
